title: zoysia seslerioides
intro: Zoysia seslerioides, commonly known as Japanese shoal grass, is a type of grass native to Southeast Asia and parts of the Pacific Islands. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Zoysia seslerioides include its potential in treating various health conditions such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
